sections.name: Harness and Saddle Bay
sections.entryLabel: Step through the side door into the harness bay
sections.caption: Within the carriage house · beyond the left doorway
sections.message: The same doorway returns to the vehicle bay. The maintenance card, harness buckle and linen trunk belong to this outbuilding.
sections.alt: Small harness-and-saddle bay inside Gerouge carriage house, with an open left door showing the carriage wheel, a maintenance card and buckle on the bench and a linen trunk on the right.

sections.name: Under-Stair Coat Recess
sections.entryLabel: Step into the under-stair coat recess
sections.caption: Within the entrance hall · beneath the stair
sections.message: A shallow coat recess opens directly back into the entrance hall. The staircase and flower table remain visible through the same opening.
sections.alt: Coat-and-umbrella recess under the entrance-hall stair, with one opening back to the same hall.
hotspots: Inspect the hall coat and umbrella stand

sections.name: Classroom Chalk and Cloak Recess
sections.caption: Within the classroom · chalk and cloaks
sections.message: The side doorway opens into a shallow classroom store. Return through the green-trimmed opening to the same desks.
sections.alt: Shallow green-trimmed classroom storage recess with chalk, slates and cloaks and one opening back to the classroom desks.
hotspots: Examine the chalk box and route slate

sections.name: Annex Linen Recess
sections.caption: Within the annex · linen storage
sections.message: Linen shelves fill a shallow recess off the annex. The iron beds remain visible through its only doorway.
sections.alt: Annex linen recess with household shelves and a single left doorway returning to the annex iron beds.
hotspots: Read the annex linen inventory tag
